profileSelection.owner: server deployment configuration only; anonymous request cannot select or raise a profile
profileSelection.scope: all API replicas serving one environment must use the same configured profile
profileSelection.persistedAs: Inquiry.uploadProfileCode, assigned at creation and immutable
profileSelection.sourceQuotaChange: The source/UTC-day Redis counter is shared across Inquiry IDs. Its effective byte cap is the lowest profile cap seen for that source and UTC day; a profile change never resets, refunds or widens a charged daily bucket before UTC rollover.

sharedControls.storage: Existing configured private StoragePort only; random keys, bounded streaming, exact-object cleanup and capacity monitoring are required.

MVP_SAFE.enablement: Frozen default; production intake remains blocked until legal approval and a real scanner is operational.

ENGINEERING_DOCUMENTS.enablement: Explicit server configuration only after owner approval, operational scanner confirmation, representative runtime fixtures and StoragePort capacity review.

charging.sourceDailyQuota: Atomically charge declared bytes when an upload intent is accepted, across all Inquiries for the HMAC source fingerprint and UTC day. Same-key replay is not charged twice; failed, cancelled and expired intents are not refunded for that day.
charging.inquiryQuota: Count completed objects by actual bytes and active ISSUED/RECEIVING reservations by declared bytes under the Inquiry lock.

streaming.bodyBuffering: Never load the whole request body or source document into memory. Enforce backpressure and stream from NestJS into the private quarantine StoragePort.
streaming.memoryBound: Application byte buffers are at most 1 MiB per stream and at most four streams per API process (4 MiB aggregate application payload buffer), excluding socket/TLS, runtime, storage SDK and scanner memory.
streaming.scanner: Accepted bytes remain QUARANTINED. Only an actually configured scanner can mark CLEAN or REJECTED; no scanner or scanner error means no download or extraction.

runtimeFixtures: Known benign PDF, CSV and XLSX fixtures; verify detected type and hash without storing customer data.
Generated streaming fixtures at each profile's exact file/inquiry boundary and one byte above it, with backpressure and bounded-memory assertions.
Maximum file-count and aggregate-byte reservation races, including two Inquiries sharing one source/day bucket and a profile-cap decrease that never widens the bucket.
Four concurrent streams and rejection of excess per-source/process concurrency; a bounded slow stream and an idle stream that expires using an injected clock/short test timeout.
Malformed, signature-mismatched, oversized and ZIP-bomb-like XLSX fixtures; reject unsafe structures or keep them quarantined without extraction.
DOCX, DOCM, XLSM, DWG, DXF, ZIP, 7Z and RAR fixtures are rejected by the frozen allowlist; no archive traversal/extraction is attempted.
Scanner CLEAN, REJECTED, absent, timeout and error outcomes; absent/error never permit download.
StoragePort unavailable, interrupted stream and exact-owned temporary-object cleanup; no volume or unrelated object cleanup.
